item.title: GitHub Copilot June 2026 Billing: My $425 Reality Check
item.description: A Copilot Pro+ subscriber ($39/mo) reveals that under GitHub Copilot's new June 2026 per-token billing, their April usage would cost $141 and May $425 — and what cheaper LLM alternatives to explore next.
